capabilities: Type delimiters to wrap selections in new Markdown formats
Insert underline, spoiler, superscript, subscript and span formats from commands or the format menu
Customise highlight colours and save reusable CSS classes in settings
Enable or disable individual syntax formats
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.7.4 or later; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Documents known limits such as unescapable spoiler delimiters in table cells in Source mode.
intentEvidence: If you are switching from Extended Markdown Syntax, disable the old plugin, copy its data.json into the new plugin folder
problem: Obsidian's Markdown lacks built-in syntax for underline, spoilers, superscript, subscript, coloured highlights, custom spans and fenced divs.

relations.evidence: Maintained by soizo. Based on Extended Markdown Syntax by Kotaindah55 (Sheva Ihza).
Thanks to Pandoc, CommonMark, GitHub Flavoured Markdown, Discord

summary: Markdown syntax plugin that adds delimiters for underlines, spoilers, superscripts, subscripts, coloured highlights, custom spans and fenced divs.
